notes.title: Full Release Update! (1.0.0)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/8968451793bcf6e24a8cfb7dc108761e54c85c69.png

There's no beating around the bush here, we've gone all out to make the Girldivers final update as special as possible!

New Girldiver: Princess!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/2b7c475b96ecc619af766114bedeb30064be2a4d.png

Added Outfits
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/f02ce9d747e8e6839dd70a606d94643f8cc7d79b.png

New Campaign Path, New Planets, New Difficulty
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/1f1f26679d9d77f796a1c912c8ac42c1deb7c723.png

Controller Support + Key Rebinding
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/2c02614a227560bb9daf194ae745a561fefbd3e3.png

The Beach Update
We were deep into making the "Beach Update" DLC which included the new outfits and much of the new game content. As a thanks for our first big game we decided to release it all as 100% free content for the full release!

Full 1.0.0 Changes
Highlighted Changes

Added new Girldiver: Princess! She does not need to be purchased, you can unlock her at "Little Wave" on the campaign map.
Added outifts system to the game & wardobe to the ship.
Added 12 unique outfits.
Added 3 new story events & illustrations to the game.
Added controller support (controller mode) to the game.
Added key rebinding.
Added Island planets!
New HARD path in the campaign spanning 8 planets.
Added auto saving: The game will now save when you return to the ship instead of just when you exit the game. So if you crash or lose power you'll be able to resume at your last ship stop.
Added 6 new achievements
  -> "Princess Joins The Crew!" - "Recruit the lovely Princess to join the adventure"
  -> "New Path" - "Unlocked difficulty level 9"
 -> "Unreal" - "Unlocked difficulty level 10"
 -> "Spider Dash!" - "Begin the hardest path in the game."
 -> "The Unstoppable Princess" - "Liberate planets along the hardest path in the game."
 -> "How?! (The Perfect 4)" - "Beat the hardest path in the game."

New

New Weapon: Squirter
New Armor: Beach Panties.
Added 2 new underground maps to the underground objective.
Added game cursors for menu & aiming: No longer just your default PC Cursor!
Clicking or pressing space will now speed up the mission end screen.
Added controls category window to settings.
Added eagle sound effect to planting flags.
Added a hit flash effect to the final boss.
Added a weapon laser attachment when playing with controller.
Added princess version of every weapon sprite so she has purple hands.
Added 'control scheme select' screen (if game is launched not using any parameters)

Balancing

Buffed Sub: Missive damage (32~41 -> 34~42)
Buffed Pressure Sensitive Liberty Bombs damage (150->160)
Buffed Victoria Gun Run gadget damage per impact (40->50)
Buffed Victoria Bombing Run gadget damage per bomb (100->120)
Buffed B.O.O.B damage (48~57 -> 50~60)
Buffed Hot Shot Rocket damage (300->400)
Reduced self-damage taken from Hot Shot R3ocket (21->20)
Reduced self-damage taken from mines (15%->12%)
Grenades now explode faster (1s->0.7s)
Buffed Nature's Breastplate armor (800->1000)

Changes

Adjusted 'time to beat' on final mission, beating the level before the timer goes orange means you're within 15 seconds of my personal record (3:30).
Made so you can use escape to exit the 'thanks for playing' screen.
Big changes to how character assets (in-game sprite frames & outfit frames) are loaded to reduce loading time & memory use.
Recolored the 'retreat' button in the escape menu so it's easier to avoid accidentally clicking it.
Moved Hologirl & her dialogue window on the shop so the stats window obscures less.
Updated the design of the settings screen.
Updated all control displays to pull from the rebind system.
Fixed the close button being off-center in Miss Victoria's screen.
As requested, the game cursor is now confined to the game window.
Reduced scroll sensitivity on all scrollbars for a nicer experience.
Updated French & Russian translations thanks to community submissions on Discord.

Fixes

Fixed dialogue window in the shop scaling incorrectly on different resolutions.
Fixed version text blending into the background.
Fixed planets displaying difficulty stars weird if you went above difficulty 7.

Fun Fact

Originally the game was going to use steam launch options to put the player into keyboard or controller mode. But I decided it was a nicer experience to add it as an in-game menu. But you can still force the game to launch into either keyboard or gamepad mode using the following command line parameters (launch options):
-control_keyboard
-control_gamepad

Thanks for reading ;3
~Captain Cake

notes.title: The Cat Update! (0.8.0)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/6d7382b4b48338b2eb3752d0865378c4c05d707d.png
*Some notes thrown in for those who missed yesterday's news!

Mittens Joins The Crew!
After Dash realizes that her beloved cat Mittens can be trusted nowhere else but by the side of the Girldivers, Mittens was sworn in & made an official part of the crew!

Once you liberate the planet "Mitten's Cage", rescue Mittens, and thank the poor kitty's protector, you will find that a comfy fuzzball miraculously appears by your bed in the ship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/205921a0287f1bcf56d5d0715d1e4391a145036c.png

Now that Dash has brought aboard your new feline friend, you can decide how you want them to participate in the Girldivers program. Stay on the ship and be cute or have them follow you around during your missions.

And don't worry, Super Earth has space helmets specially designed for pets so they can accompany you on Luna missions. Or maybe you think those helmets look fashionable, there's a setting to have your pet always wear their helmet:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/ef2ebb356d33ee6c0d1c5a32c2372e296e6f024c.png

Truly, the puurrfect companion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/9610e5037d73a9a810ceb06c379d7b02e631d8b9.gif

0.8.0 Changes
We've been hard at work on the game's full release coming November 15th and decided to do something fun for everyone waiting, so we hope you enjoy.

Main

 Added Mittens & their cat bed to the game!

Balancing

 All shotguns have had their damage buffed ~10+%.
 Buffed Speed Panties speed bonus slightly (5->6).
 Haunted Gloves now provide a small speed bonus.

New

 Ammo text now changes colors based off of how much ammo you have left.
 Added setting to have Mittens always wear their space helmet (including in the ship).

For those who missed it
Thank you everyone who participated! When deciding what new diver to add for the full release November 15th, we received an incredible 402 votes on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/1e7568eb0dcef8ffde2c2d7adcd297a77590643b.png

The winner with 235 votes was the Spider Girl! We're already deep into the process of getting her into the game for full release including a new campaign path, game sprite, a new cute officer mission, and story shots!

We're also hard at work on the full release update which will have all that content, a new weapon, new gadget, and new features like key rebinding and auto saving.

Lets play!

Thanks for reading ;3
~Captain Cake

notes.title: Demo & Small Update + News (0.7.5)
notes.notes:
The Demo
When we first made the demo, it was made as a spin-off of the game. It required new programming & work in order to do it. This meant that we had to make a separate version of the game every time we wanted to update the demo, as a result it lagged behind the updates of the main game.

No more! We spent the time to merge the demo functionality into the main game so that way we can make updates to the demo without needing to reinvent the wheel each time lol. The demo versioning will now match the main game's versioning, and the demo has all at once received the changes that have been done to the game.

Here are all the updates that have now been applied to the demo:
Changelog 0.6.9.1
Changelog 0.7.0
"Combat 2 Update" Changelog 0.7.1
(This one, 0.7.5)
TLDR: Tons of balancing changes, UI overhauls & improvements, bug fixes, new settings, quality of life changes, lots of great stuff!

If you enjoy the demo, the game will be going on sale October 13~15th & a sale on full release November 15th.

0.7.5 Changes
We wanted to bring the demo up to date before we pushed the next update we're going to be doing. Although this update is focused on that, we do have one change:

 Fixed a bug where a planet would be counted as being beat multiple times.
 Updated Russian & Spanish localization to the game.

Update coming later this week
We wanted to release this first since we have an update coming out in the next few days and don't want the demo to keep falling behind the main game. If all goes well, we might even have the update released tomorrow!

We've been hard at work on the game's full release coming November 15th and decided to do something fun for everyone waiting, so we hope you enjoy.

The Vote
Thank you everyone who participated! We received an incredible 402 votes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/1e7568eb0dcef8ffde2c2d7adcd297a77590643b.png

The winner with 235 votes was the Spider Girl! We're already deep into the process of getting her into the game for full release including a new campaign path, game sprite, a new cut officer mission, and story shots!

notes.title: Combat 2 Update (0.7.1)
notes.notes:
(This update adds on to a change started with the last update, you can read the 0.7.0 patch notes here)

The Update
Why "Combat 2"? Because the first big combat changes were done for the demo 2.0 release on Steam!
(Which are very interesting, highly recommend you read the Steam patch notes if you want to see how much things have changed to get the game to where it is now).

We continue to be incredibly grateful for the positive response to the game & all of the feedback!
Also love the chats happening in Discord <3

UI Redesigns
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/cdb20ddccd1399a01709ffac7c41af545cef6aa3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073760/509a9a4c9cf00f57134082620024ffdc5fd7e08d.png

Highlighted Changes

 Added auto reload feature, on by default, can be turned off in settings
 Redesigned the gadget menu
 Gadget menu is now toggled instead of held
 Redesigned settings display. Now horizontal instead of vertical. New colors. Now organized by category (Audio, Display, Gameplay)

Quality of life

 Added "Dont show again" option/toggle to the 'Thanks for playing' screen

Fixes

 Removed 2 achievements from the game that couldn't be earned (They were for difficulty 9 & 10 which existed in an earlier version of the campaign). Achievement hunters may now rest easy!
 Fixed soft lock in tutorial where you could use supply gadget to kill yourself with grenades
 Fixed soft lock in tutorial where you could throw a gadget before you were supposed to
 Fixed not getting achievement for buying a character if you used a demo save file
 Fixed not getting achievement for a planet if you had completed it in a demo save file
 Fixed weapon firing a shot at the same time as gadget throw, resulting in losing some ammo
 Fixed weapons that fire multiple projectiles only counting as 1 shot fired in game stats, causing more than 100% accuracy. Accuracy is calculated as (Shots Hit / Shots Fired), so this will fix 'shots fired' moving forward but won't change the number for your existing saves)
 Fixed bug where opening the gadgets menu before you received a gadget would result in the gadgets menu showing placeholder data


Thoughts
Combat:
I didn't realize how much these 2 changes would effect how I played the game. Originally I was hesitant to add auto reload because I thought it might take away from the experience, but once I did it I am happy that I did. For those who prefer the previous system, I added the ability to toggle it on/off in the settings. I've made it default to on so that it is now the main game experience for players.

The gadgets menu also changed how I played the game a lot more than I thought it would.
You can thank this Steam discussion by ruff1298 for suggesting the change.

The gadget menu being toggled on made me pay a lot more attention to my gadgets, combined with no longer needing to hold down control in order to use gadget hotkeys, I found myself using gadgets way more than I ever did before. And by adding bars, and then coloring them, it's easy to tell the state of each gadget at a glance.

Originally I was going to do away with the control key altogether but I figured making it a toggle instead of permanently visible lets players hide the gadget info if they want to.

Settings:
The settings menu was formerly a big vertical window. I thought it looked cool but around when I added full screen & resolution options, I quickly realized size was going to be a problem. Then, adding 'auto reload' in this update I decided it definitely needed a redesign. This helps to allow more settings on the screen but also, organizing by category just makes it an easier / nicer player experience.

Goal & thanks:
My goal is to start working more on new content, both for Early Access & full release. This might take a bit so I'm happy to get some big changes like this done so quickly.

Your support during Early Access is what lets this be possible, so thank you very much!

Overall, I'm super happy with the state of the game & the positive feedback!

Lets play!
Join us on 18+ Discord (New art, Updates, Chat) :)
View the Demo
Full Game

Thanks for reading ;3
~Captain Cake

notes.title: Update (0.7.0)
notes.notes:
Fantastic Launch
The game's big release on Steam has allowed players a chance to play further into the game content, as well as allow a lot more players to be exposed to it. As a result, we have a lot more feedback than we did with the demos!

We're very happy with the response so far!

Thanks to this new feedback, we're introducing some changes to make the game even better!

Changes

Highlighted Change

 You can now use gadget hotkeys without needing to hold down left control. Control is now just used to bring up the menu.

Balancing

 Reduced Tunneller projectile collision size
 Reduced Tunneller projectile speed by 22%
 Increased distance at which Tunneller will start spitting projectiles
 Increased Tunneller cooldown between spits
 Reduced the damage the player takes from their own rockets by 30%
 Reduced the damage the player takes from their own grenades by 30%
 Buffed Victoria Gun Run's damage per bullet by 25%
 Buffed Victoria Bombing Run's damage per bomb by 11%
 Reduced Victoria Bombing Run's damage to the player by 17%
 Made the inside of enemy artillery warning circle slightly red (Some users, when first encountering the artillery, thought because it was fully transparent that the inside of the circle was safe)
 Increased how long the player is immune to damage after respawning
 Reduced Supply Package gadget deploy time (4 seconds -> 2 seconds)
 Reduced Hot Shot Rocket gadget deploy time (3 seconds -> 2 seconds)
 Reduced Hot Shot Rocket gadget cooldown time (200 seconds -> 120 seconds)
 Reduced Extra Life gadget deploy time (3 seconds -> 2 seconds)

Fixes

 Fixed pilot dialogue being stuck open if you die before it closes
 Fixed Holo Girl tutorial text for gadgets accidentally including control text for [LMB] on the line about being your first

Small Changes

 Renamed "Superstar Celebrity Diver" achievement to "Superstar Diver"
 Fixed "Council" not being capitalized on line 4 of Dash's lose event
